privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: RexFoot privacy policy: data collected, cookies, and your rights.
privacy.introBody: This privacy policy describes how RexFoot (rexfoot.com) handles data when you browse the site and, where applicable, use the RexFoot Android app.
privacy.dataBody:
Browsing without an account: no personal data is collected. An anonymous technical identifier (cookie) may be set to count page views for statistical purposes, with no link to your identity.
Creating an account (optional): email address, password (stored encrypted, never in plain text), display name and, if you choose, a profile picture. This information is used to sign you in, manage your favorites and, if enabled, display a public profile.
Audience measurement: RexFoot may use an analytics tool (e.g. Google Analytics) to understand overall site usage through aggregated, anonymous statistics.
privacy.useBody: The data collected is used solely to operate the site and app (sign-in, favorites, profile display), improve the service, and keep it secure (limiting abuse, preventing fraud).
privacy.sharingBody:
RexFoot does not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for any purpose.
Your data is only shared with the technical providers strictly necessary to operate the site (hosting, database), who access it only to perform the requested services and are bound by confidentiality.
privacy.cookiesBody:
RexFoot uses Google AdSense to display advertisements on the site. Google and its partners may set cookies or use similar identifiers to personalize the ads shown, measure their performance, and combat fraud. For visitors located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, a consent banner is displayed to collect your agreement before these advertising cookies are set. You may change your choice at any time via this banner or your browser settings. To learn more about how Google uses data: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites
A technical cookie may also be used to keep you signed in if you have an account, remember your preferences (such as language), or anonymously count page views.
privacy.rightsBody: You may at any time request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, as well as deletion of your account, by writing to the address below. Requests are handled within a reasonable timeframe, in accordance with applicable data protection law.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about this privacy policy or your personal data, you can contact RexFoot at: footrexofficial@gmail.com.

legal.dataBody:
When creating an account on RexFoot, certain information may be requested, including an email address and a display name.
RexFoot commits to never selling users' personal data or sharing it with third parties for advertising purposes.
The site uses Google AdSense to display advertisements; Google and its partners may use cookies for this purpose, with consent collected from users located in the EU, the United Kingdom and Switzerland. See the Privacy Policy for more details.
Users may request the deletion of their account and associated data from their "My account" area, where this feature is available, or by sending a request to: footrexofficial@gmail.com.
